translations.web: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
translations.bsb: The LORD of Hosts has purposed, and who can thwart Him? His hand is outstretched, so who can turn it back?
translations.kjv: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
translations.asv: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall annul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
